summary.description: Two or three sentences: what the change does and the overall risk picture.

reviewed.description: What was actually examined: files read, callers traced, commands run. Lets the caller see what was NOT covered.

category.description: Short kebab-case slug, e.g. logic, security, concurrency, error-handling, data-loss, api-contract, missed-requirement, test-gap, performance.

line.description: 1-based line in the post-change file, or null if not line-specific.

claim.description: The defect, stated as a falsifiable assertion about the code.

failure_scenario.description: Concrete input or state, then the wrong behavior it produces.

evidence.description: The code you read that supports the claim, quoted or paraphrased with locations.

confidence.description: 0 to 1. How sure you are the defect is real, not how severe it is.
